name: ripple
title: Ripple
description: An animated ripple effect typically used behind elements to emphasize them.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the container (it fades to the bottom with a mask by default).

props.name: mainCircleSize
props.description: Diameter of the innermost circle in pixels. Each further circle is 70px wider.

props.name: mainCircleOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the innermost circle. Each further circle is 0.03 more transparent.
